newsitem.title: USA: Sonoco sells tennis ball container unit.
newsitem.headline: Sonoco sells tennis ball container unit.

text.p: Sonoco Products Cor said Thursday it signed a letter of intent with Ring Can Corp to sell its plastic container operation located in Greenville, S.C.
Selling price for this operation was not disclosed.
The companies hope to have the sale completed before year end, Sonoco said, adding it will continue to provide the plant with metal-end closures for the tennis ball containers.
The plant employs about 25. Ring said it does not expect any personnel changes as a result of this sale.
"While this was a strong operation for Sonoco, it does not fit with our major product lines," the company explained.
